newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALINVEST SETS UP BALTIC INVESTMENT BANK - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: TALINVEST SETS UP BALTIC INVESTMENT BANK - REPORT.

text.p: Talinvest, an investment house based in Tallinn, will establish in April an investment bank with offices in the three Baltic states, Aripaev business newspaper said on Tuesday.
The pan-Baltic investment bank will be called Talinvest-Suprema Baltic Securities Ltd and will offer investment services in all three Baltic stock exchanges, the newspaper added.
When Talinvest bought Suprema it said that it would form a pan-Baltic investment bank.
"With this move we are separating our client service from strategic investments," Peeter Saks, managing director of Talinvest, told the newspaper.
The new invesment bank is hoping to see a large number of foreign investors interested in investing in Baltic securities, Saks added.
Talinvest bought 87 percent of Lithuanian securities firm Suprema, which has 20 percent of the local market.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom +372 630 8400 reuters@reut ers.ee
